The Downs line is an internal inconsistency in the post as transcribed (this corpus's own file places Downs in Indianapolis); it is transcribed as posted and flagged, not corrected silently, and Downs' team is not asserted from this post. Split samples are route subsets (69 to 119 routes for the named Chiefs). All values poster-stated, CITED, UNVERIFIED. The post does not credit a source in its text; the table format matches the FantasyPtsData family, recorded as an observation, not a credit. Feed row 98.
